title: Bifrost UDT Definition
description: Protocol-independent UDT data contract (Sparkplug Template-shaped): the unit of source of truth in the Bifrost registry. Language-neutral — any consumer can validate a definition document against this schema without depending on Bifrost code.

templateRef.description: Reference to a parent template this UDT extends, or null if this is a root definition.

version.description: SemVer of this definition, serialized as a major.minor.patch string.

type.description: Type name, as returned by MetricDataType.toString() (members) or ParameterDataType.toString() (params), e.g. "Double", "Boolean", "Int32".
